stateNote: Transfer dough to a board dusted with powdered sugar. Dust a rolling pin with powdered sugar and flatten out the dough until it’s ¼ inch thick and spread out on the board , roughly in a rectangular shape. It may be preferable to roll it out on a countertop first and transfer it to a board afterwards. Alternatively, you may find it easier to roll the dough between two sheets of wax paper (both dusted with powdered sugar).
